facts.business: Kesar Petroproducts Limited is a leading manufacturer of Phthalocyanine Blue Crude and its downstream products in India, contributing up to 15% of the country's Copper Phthalocyanine market with a global presence in 15 countries.

segments.name: Phthalocyanine Blue Crude and downstream products

capacity_or_capex.item: Copper Phthalocyanine Blue Crude production capacity
Captive power plant and zero liquid discharge project
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Likely to be completed in financial year ending 31.3.2026

guidance_or_targets.statement: Priority will be on quality of products, cost reductions, operating efficiencies, diligent cash deployment in value creating opportunities, and increasing product line to increase margins

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Secretarial audit observations: 1) Website not updated timely per Regulation 44 of SEBI LODR; 2) Additional measures needed for effective implementation of Structured Digital Database for insider trading compliance

key_risks: Steep countervailing duty imposed by China on Phthalocyanine imports from India causing loss of business
Raw material cost volatility linked to crude oil prices
Environmental compliance and wastewater treatment requirements
Global trade tensions and trade war with US affecting pigment demand
Slow economic revival with inflationary pressures and depreciating rupee
Logistics disruptions due to geopolitical conflicts (war in Europe)
facts.related_party_note: Facility leased from Shreyas Intermediates Limited for running operations
